name: hadeda-flap
description: Hadeda Flap, a one-tap portrait flyer.

scripts.cap:sync: node tools/sync-www.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: node tools/sync-www.mjs && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.aab:release: node tools/sync-www.mjs && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
